title: stellaria ruscifolia var. aleutica
intro: Stellaria ruscifolia var. aleutica, commonly known as Aleutian starwort, is a perennial plant species in the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Aleutian starwort include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
